gloss: to run; to dash; to gallop

definitions.gloss: to run; to dash; to sprint
definitions.explanation: To run swiftly, often with a sense of urgency or energy. More literary and vivid than {走|はし}る.

definitions.gloss: to gallop; to ride at speed
definitions.explanation: For a horse or mounted rider to move at full speed. Used in historical and equestrian contexts.

notes:
An ichidan verb. More dynamic and literary than ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run). Often appears in compound verbs.

COMMON COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧ (dash up)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{下|お}りる→駆け下りる：06111_kakeoriru⟧ (dash down)
- ⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧ (rush to the scene)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}ける→駆け抜ける：06114_kakenukeru⟧ (dash through)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧ (run around)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧ (rush into)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ is the standard neutral word for running. {駆|か}ける is more vivid and implies speed, urgency, or dynamic motion. ⟦{疾走|しっそう}→疾走：13666_shissou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is even more formal and literary.
